name: Agentcard
description: Agentcard gives AI agents one-time virtual cards for card-rail checkout: fund a wallet, set spend caps and human approvals, and the agent mints a fresh single-use card that works at any merchant that accepts cards. A complementary card rail alongside x402 machine-native payments, with wallets funded via Coinbase CDP Onramp; agents connect over a remote MCP server, REST API, or CLI.
